title: Picarones con Cajeta y Cajeta de Cajeta
description: Picarones are traditional Peruvian doughnuts that are typically served with cajeta, a sweet sauce made from goat's milk. This recipe combines the two with a twist by using a yellowed variety of sweet potato for added depth of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
Using a piping bag or a plastic bag with a corner cut off, pipe the dough into rings.
Fry the picarones for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Drain the picarones on paper towels and dust with cinnamon and anise.
In a medium saucepan, combine the cajeta and heavy cream.
Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low and let cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the sauce thickens slightly.
Serve the picarones warm with the cajeta sauce drizzled on top.
